verdict.rationale: Every Gitea instance ships an interactive Swagger UI at /api/swagger, enabled by default and live-verified on gitea.com. Its try-it feature runs requests against the instance's own live API, and the API usage guide documents it alongside a machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI spec. The probe 404s on docs.gitea.com paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served from instance paths. Missing for 10: a documented hosted test or sandbox instance (try-it only hits a live instance, not an isolated environment), curated runnable examples beyond the auto-generated Swagger operations, and independent or community corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Every Gitea instance ships an interactive Swagger UI reference at /api/swagger (mounted against the instance's own OpenAPI document, so try-it executes against the live instance API)
API Reference guide is auto-generated by swagger and available on: https://gitea.your.host/api/swagger
The OpenAPI document is at: https://gitea.your.host/swagger.v1.json
